tables.name: mop_backup_archive_event
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mop_backup_archive_event_pkey ON public.mop_backup_archive_event USING btree (tenant_id, version_id, event_version)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mop_backup_archive_event_tenant_id_version_id_command_id_key ON public.mop_backup_archive_event USING btree (tenant_id, version_id, command_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mop_backup_archive_dispatch_once ON public.mop_backup_archive_event USING btree (tenant_id, dispatch_id) WHERE ((action)::text = 'START_STORE'::text)

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_event_action_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['STAGE'::character varying, 'START_STORE'::character varying, 'MARK_UNCONFIRMED'::character varying, 'CONFIRM_NO_DISPATCH'::character varying, 'VERIFY_OBJECT'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_event_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((dispatch_count = 0) AND (dispatch_id IS NULL) AND (dispatch_owner IS NULL)) OR ((dispatch_count > 0) AND (dispatch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (dispatch_owner IS NOT NULL) AND (length((dispatch_owner)::text) > 0) AND ((dispatch_owner)::text !~ '[^A-Za-z0-9._:-]'::text))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_event_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((action)::text = 'STAGE'::text) AND ((phase)::text = 'STAGED'::text) AND (event_version = 0) AND (dispatch_count = 0)) OR (((action)::text = 'START_STORE'::text) AND ((phase)::text = 'STORE_STARTED'::text) AND (event_version > 0) AND (dispatch_count > 0)) OR (((action)::text = 'MARK_UNCONFIRMED'::text) AND ((phase)::text = 'VERIFY_REQUIRED'::text) AND (event_version > 0) AND (dispatch_count > 0)) OR (((action)::text = 'CONFIRM_NO_DISPATCH'::text) AND ((phase)::text = 'STAGED'::text) AND (event_version > 0) AND (dispatch_count > 0)) OR (((action)::text = 'VERIFY_OBJECT'::text) AND ((phase)::text = 'VERIFIED'::text) AND (event_version > 0))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_event_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CONFIRM_NO_DISPATCH'::character varying, 'VERIFY_OBJECT'::character varying])::text[])) AND (evidence_reference IS NOT NULL) AND ((evidence_reference)::text ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) OR (((action)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['CONFIRM_NO_DISPATCH'::character varying, 'VERIFY_OBJECT'::character varying])::text[])) AND (evidence_reference IS NULL))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_event_observed_at_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((observed_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (observed_at <= '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999+00'::timestamp with time zone)))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_event_phase_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((phase)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['STAGED'::character varying, 'STORE_STARTED'::character varying, 'VERIFY_REQUIRED'::character varying, 'VERIFIED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_event_tenant_id_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, version_id) REFERENCES mop_backup_archive_submission(tenant_id, version_id)

tables.name: mop_backup_archive_submission

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mop_backup_archive_submission_tenant_id_submission_id_key ON public.mop_backup_archive_submission USING btree (tenant_id, submission_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mop_backup_archive_submission_tenant_id_run_id_attempt_numb_key ON public.mop_backup_archive_submission USING btree (tenant_id, run_id, attempt_number)
CREATE INDEX mop_backup_archive_submission_asset ON public.mop_backup_archive_submission USING btree (tenant_id, asset_id, recorded_at DESC, version_id DESC)

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_submission_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((SUBSTRING(encoded_envelope FROM 1 FOR 195) = ((((((((((((int2send((24)::smallint) || convert_to('MOP_BACKUP_AES256_GCM_V1'::text, 'UTF8'::name)) || int2send((11)::smallint)) || convert_to('AES-256-GCM'::text, 'UTF8'::name)) || int2send((36)::smallint)) || convert_to((tenant_id)::text, 'UTF8'::name)) || int2send((36)::smallint)) || convert_to((asset_id)::text, 'UTF8'::name)) || int2send((36)::smallint)) || convert_to((run_id)::text, 'UTF8'::name)) || int4send(attempt_number)) || int2send((36)::smallint)) || convert_to((version_id)::text, 'UTF8'::name))))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_submission_recorded_at_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((recorded_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (recorded_at <= '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999+00'::timestamp with time zone)))

constraints.name: mop_backup_archive_submission_tenant_id_asset_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, asset_id) REFERENCES mop_asset(tenant_id, id)
